description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class for the GuzzleHttp library, which handles retry logic for HTTP requests based on a user-defined 'decider' callback. It includes methods for managing retries with exponential backoff delays.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class enabling configurable retry logic for HTTP requests, including customizable delay strategies and retry decision-making.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decider, next handler, and optional delay function for retry logic.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing default exponential backoff delay in milliseconds based on the number of retries.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware handling request, managing retries via the decider and delay functions.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Handles successful response, deciding whether to retry based on the decider callback.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Handles failed response or exception, deciding whether to retry based on the decider callback.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs a retry with the appropriate delay, incrementing the retry count.
